name: lottie-ios
description_en: An iOS library to natively render After Effects vector animations
readme_excerpt: Lottie for iOS View documentation, FAQ, help, examples, and more at airbnb.io/lottie Lottie is a cross-platform library for iOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, Android, and Web that natively renders vector-based animations and art in realtime with minimal code. Lottie loads and renders animations and vectors exported in the bodymovin JSON format. Bodymovin JSON can be created and exported from After Effects with bodymovin, Sketch with Lottie Sketch Export, and from Haiku. Designers can create and ship…
